ASW using IEC61131-3 for RC4x devices can be developed using the combination of easyConfig + CODESYS IDE + BODAS-RTS package

 

 

 

## 1. Configure BSW in easyConfig {#configure-bsw-in-easyconfig .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

## See easyConfig documentation for more details on your BSW configuration. {#see-easyconfig-documentation-for-more-details-on-your-bsw-configuration. .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

##   {#section .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

 

 

## 2. Install CODESYS {#install-codesys .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

To develop ASW using CODESYS IDE, install CODESYS V3.5.21.40 32-bit for RC5-6, and CODESYS V3.5.21.40 32-bit for RC18-12 & RC27-18. The installation package can be downloaded directly from [CODESYS store](https://store.codesys.com/codesys.html#Alle%20Versionen){.weblink target="_blank"}.

 

## 3. Get BODAS-RTS package {#get-bodas-rts-package .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

After configuring BSW using easyConfig and successful software build, the build download includes a folder BODAS-RTS.

The BODAS-RTS package is a combination of software plug-ins and files that are needed together with CODESYS IDE to develop ASW for RC4x devices. The artefacts of BODAS-RTS package are detailed in the below table.

  Artefact                      Location
  ----------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Gateway.cfg                   myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/GatewayCFG
  Device Description            myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports
  BODAS-API library             myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports
  easyConfig files              myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports/easyConfig
  Additional CODESYS plug-ins   myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/CodesysImports/AdditionalPlugins.zip
  BODAS-RTS hex file            myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/hex
  BODAS-RTS a2l file            myBODAS build download - BODAS-RTS/hex
